A. 6.614
B. 6.615
C. 6.617
D. 6.618

1.  **Solution Setup**: 1 kg of water at 150°C was defined. 2.  **Redox Reactions**: PHREEQC calculates the thermodynamic equilibrium including potential redox reactions. Under the specified conditions, methane and ammonia participate in redox equilibria (e.g., the reduction of CO$_2$ by NH$_3$ to form CH$_4$ and N$_2$).
